title: A Musielak-Orlicz approach for modeling uncertainties in long-memory processes
summary: This paper proposes a novel mathematical framework for modeling uncertainties in supOU processes, a common model for long-memory phenomena. We address uncertainties as distortions in reversion and Levy measures, evaluating them simultaneously via state-dependent divergence functions on Musielak-Orlicz spaces. The core of our approach involves solving optimization problems to determine the upper- and lower-bounds of cumulants under a prescribed uncertainty set.
